canonical_project: PVM Invensys / Polo Towers Group / CtrlS data centre interest (Tripura)
owner: PVM Invensys Pvt Ltd; Polo Towers Group; CtrlS Datacenters (interest only)
notes: At the Airtel DC bhoomi pujan (29 Jan 2026) CM Saha stated several investment companies - Airtel, PVM Invensys Pvt Ltd, Polo Towers Group and CtrlS - have expressed interest in setting up data centres in Tripura.
